summary: Curaleaf filed an 8-K on September 15, 2026, disclosing a press release urging Aurora Cannabis shareholders to tender into its outstanding offer and realize a 45% premium, becoming owners of the world's largest cannabis company. Chairman/CEO Boris Jordan issued the letter and will host a shareholder Q&A on September 17. The filing, made via Rule 425 written communications, provides no price per share, consideration mix, board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory clock. The structural angle is an unsolicited exchange offer pressuring Aurora holders; watch tender conditions, Aurora's board response, and any competing bid.
